name: Long-Term Resident Status -- EU (Third-Country National)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires 5 years of continuous lawful stay in Luxembourg (absences under 6 consecutive months, or certain longer absences for pregnancy/illness/education, do not break continuity).
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 5 years of continuous lawful residence.

requirements.blocker_text: Must show stable, regular and sufficient resources to support self and dependents without recourse to social welfare (REVIS), assessed against the social minimum wage for unskilled workers, plus health insurance for the full 5-year period.
Criminal record clearance and suitable housing documentation also required.

evidence_required.document: Proof of 5 years' continuous lawful residence
Proof of sufficient resources and health insurance

outcome.duration_length: 5 years, renewable; permit must be returned if the holder leaves the EU for more than 6 months

sources.title: Guichet.lu -- Long-Term Resident Status for Third-Country Nationals: 5 years' continuous lawful residence, REVIS-based resources test, health insurance, criminal record, housing, 5-year renewable permit

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Luxembourg). Note this permit itself is only valid for 5 years at a time (renewable), unlike some countries' P-permits which are unlimited-validity on first grant -- the status is durable/settled in substance (long-term resident rights) but the physical document requires periodic renewal.
